executiveSummary: Western Colombia's earthquake is the week's most lethal disaster, with at least 281 people confirmed dead, hundreds still missing, and more than 25,800 families affected amid ongoing search-to-relief transition. View Article Fast-moving wildfires around Okanagan Lake, British Columbia, forced more than 20,000 people to evacuate; at least one elderly woman died and large-scale sheltering was activated. Supporting Report Typhoon Dolphin and its remnants disrupted eastern China, prompting over 300,000 relocations, 1,300+ flight cancellations, and post-landfall flooding that trapped residents. View Article Supporting Report Severe storms across the U.S. Midwest caused multiple fatalities, mass power outages, and transport disruptions, with ongoing flood rescues reported. View Article Somalia's drought continues to drive displacement into camps in Baidoa and Middle Jubba, deepening hunger and straining limited aid. View Article Hawaii faces a near-term tropical threat (Tropical Storm Lala) with hurricane warnings and high rainfall potential, requiring close monitoring. Security Advisory

topEvents.title: 1) Catastrophic Earthquake - Western Colombia
topEvents.text: At least 281 dead, hundreds missing; widespread building collapse and road failures complicate operations across Cali, Pereira, Manizales, and Quibdó. View Article

topEvents.title: 2) Okanagan Lake Wildfires - British Columbia, Canada
topEvents.text: More than 20,000 evacuated; homes destroyed; at least one fatality reported; large-scale hotel and group lodging used for shelter. Supporting Report

topEvents.title: 3) Typhoon Dolphin Impacts - Eastern China
topEvents.text: Over 300,000 relocated; 1,300+ flight cancellations; post-landfall flooding trapped residents and disrupted rail and metro services. View Article

topEvents.title: 4) Severe Storms - U.S. Midwest
topEvents.text: Multiple deaths, 600k+ power outages, halted flights at Chicago airports, and flood rescues across several states. View Article

topEvents.title: 5) Drought Displacement - Somalia (Baidoa, Middle Jubba)

escalateEvents.title: Western Colombia Earthquake - Cali, Pereira, Manizales, Quibdó
escalateEvents.text: At least 281 fatalities confirmed; hundreds remain missing; 348 rescues reported; over 25,800 families affected across multiple cities. Reporting varies as assessments continue.

escalateEvents.title: Okanagan Lake Wildfires - British Columbia, Canada
escalateEvents.text: More than 20,000 people evacuated; at least one 80-year-old woman died; dozens rescued by aircraft; large-scale hotel and group lodging secured for evacuees.

escalateEvents.title: Typhoon Dolphin & Remnants - Eastern China (Zhejiang, Fujian, Shanghai)
escalateEvents.text: Over 300,000 people relocated pre-impact; 1,300+ flight cancellations; post-landfall flooding trapped residents and disrupted metro and rail operations; related landslide impacts reported in the Philippines.

escalateEvents.title: Severe Storms - Midwest United States
escalateEvents.text: Multiple deaths, injuries, and ongoing flood rescues; widespread power outages across several states; temporary ground stops at major Chicago airports.

escalateEvents.title: Drought Displacement - Baidoa & Middle Jubba, Somalia
escalateEvents.text: Families fleeing drought arrive in camps amid hunger and shrinking aid; vulnerable households face deteriorating food security and protection risks.

escalateEvents.title: Earthquake Recovery - Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan
escalateEvents.text: 38 deaths, 114 injuries; >8,500 people in crowded shelters during extreme heat; significant building damage and water service disruptions persist.

escalateEvents.title: Wildfire - Spokane Area, Washington (U.S.)
escalateEvents.text: Thousands ordered to evacuate as a fast-moving wildfire threatened neighborhoods; public safety power shutoffs and emergency declaration enacted.

monitorEvents.title: Tropical Storm Lala - Hawaii (U.S.)
monitorEvents.text: Hurricane warning in effect; heavy rain, flooding, high winds, and dangerous surf possible this weekend; 5-10 inches of rain (locally up to 20 inches) forecast in some areas.

monitorEvents.title: Heat Wave - United Kingdom & France
monitorEvents.text: Public health alerts issued for dangerous heat; elevated risks for vulnerable populations; heat exacerbates wildfire and drought stress.

monitorEvents.title: Typhoon Dolphin (Pre-Impact) - Okinawa, Japan
monitorEvents.text: Naha Airport closed; all flights canceled; minor injuries reported; evacuation centers activated for precautionary sheltering.

monitorEvents.title: Tropical Storm Impacts - Ibaraki & Greater Tokyo, Japan
monitorEvents.text: Seven minor injuries; temporary power losses to >22,000 homes (mostly restored); lingering transport disruptions and cleanup underway.

monitorEvents.title: Wildfire & Smoke - Mount Bromo, East Java (Indonesia)
monitorEvents.text: National park and tourist areas closed due to wildfire activity; smoke impacts schools and nearby communities; no casualties reported.

outlook72h: Western Colombia: Expect continued transition from search and rescue to relief operations; unstable structures and access constraints likely persist. British Columbia (Okanagan): Ongoing evacuations and reentry restrictions possible; shelter demand and damage assessments remain priorities. Eastern China: Residual flooding and landslide risks in saturated areas; transport normalization will be gradual where infrastructure was disrupted. U.S. Midwest: Localized flood and severe-weather hazards may recur seasonally; monitor National Weather Service alerts and utility restoration timelines. Somalia: Drought-related displacement likely to continue; monitor aid pipeline and camp capacity. Hawaii: Tropical Storm Lala could bring heavy rainfall, flooding, and dangerous surf through the weekend; readiness and public warning systems should be verified. Supporting Report
regionalTrends: Americas: Concurrent high-impact hazards (Colombia earthquake; BC wildfires; U.S. severe storms) stress SAR, power, and shelter systems.
East Asia: Typhoon cycle impacts from preemptive evacuations to post-landfall urban flooding highlight cascading transport and shelter pressures.
Horn of Africa: Protracted drought continues to drive displacement and acute food insecurity in Somalia.
Heat and fire nexus: Elevated heat in parts of Europe and active wildfire seasons in North America increase risk of rapid escalation and health impacts.
